Replace only this selection’s settings with the exact JSON object below. Required settings must remain present. Raw credentials must never be entered; only opaque secret references are allowed where the frozen schema permits them. Invalid input remains visible and does not save.

Optional whole-number overrides: concurrency and latency_budget_ms must be at least 1; requests_per_day, avg_input_tokens and avg_output_tokens may be 0 or greater. Omitted keys stay unanswered. These values belong to this workload selection; the separate Workload assumptions fields are not copied or changed.

The exact catalog item defines API, managed, self-hosted or hybrid mode. This selection accepts only an empty settings object: {}. Changing the item does not adapt other components or confirm that the mode is supported.

Choose the role and enabled state explicitly. An incomplete local draft may keep this selection disabled or use another role. Snapshot preparation requires one enabled primary selection of this kind; saving here does not establish overall readiness.
